title: Free Night Awards Valuation Clause: Night Price of a Replacement Award
content:
**Clause.** The award chart's standard-season prices by category are those of the Ashbury Rewards award chart. The replacement's night price is the standard-season price of the award chart for the award category recorded on the reservation it pays, in whole points. Walk protection reads the history of the award the replacement replaces: the walked-night discount is the price on that award's latest hold, the one for its walked night, less the walked-night protected price on its latest return, the one from the relocated stay, never below zero. Half the walked-night discount, rounded down to a whole point, is taken off the night's price. The replacement's night price recorded on the hold is never below zero.

| Award category | Standard-season price (points) |
|---|---|
| 1 | 7500 |
| 2 | 12500 |
| 3 | 17500 |
| 4 | 25000 |
| 5 | 35000 |
| 6 | 45000 |
| 7 | 60000 |
| 8 | 85000 |

## Reading the clause

| Element | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| The reservation it pays | The confirmed Reward Night Rate reservation the replacement among the Free Night Awards is applied to, and its award category |
| The award the replacement replaces | The award whose reference the replacement carries |
| Price on that award's latest hold | The points price on the most recent hold record in that award's history, the hold for its walked night |
| Walked-night protected price on its latest return | The points price on the most recent return record in that award's history, the return from the relocated stay |
| The walked-night discount | The first less the second, and nil if the second is the larger |

### Worked figure (hypothetical replacement)

The reservation the replacement pays records category 4: 25000 points. The replaced award's latest hold states 30000 points and its latest return 24000 points, so the walked-night discount is 6000 points and half of it is 3000 points. The replacement's night price is 25000 less 3000, that is 22000 points.

With a hypothetical discount of 6501 points, half is 3250.5, rounded down to 3250 points.
